modelfile.paperkiln/1:
# Ollama Modelfile for model.gguf: chat template paperkiln/1 (LOCAL_LLM_STACK.md section 3, point 3).
FROM ./model.gguf
TEMPLATE """{{ $first := true }}{{ range .Messages }}{{ if eq .Role "user" }}<|user|>{{ if and $first $.System }}{{ $.System }}

{{ end }}{{ $first = false }}{{ .Content }}{{ else if eq .Role "assistant" }}<|assistant|>{{ .Content }}<|endoftext|>{{ end }}{{ end }}<|assistant|>"""
PARAMETER stop "<|endoftext|>"
PARAMETER stop "<|user|>"
PARAMETER stop "<|assistant|>"

# Ollama Modelfile for model.gguf: chat template paperkiln/2 (LOCAL_LLM_STACK.md section 3, point 3).
FROM ./model.gguf
TEMPLATE """{{ if or .System .Tools }}<|system|>{{ if .System }}{{ .System }}{{ end }}{{ if .Tools }}{{ if .System }}

{{ end }}{{ range $i, $t := .Tools }}{{ if $i }}
{{ end }}{{ json $t }}{{ end }}{{ end }}{{ end }}{{ range .Messages }}{{ if eq .Role "user" }}<|user|>{{ .Content }}{{ else if eq .Role "assistant" }}<|assistant|>{{ .Content }}{{ range .ToolCalls }}<|tool_call|>{{ .Function.Name }}
{{ json .Function.Arguments }}{{ end }}<|endoftext|>{{ else if eq .Role "tool" }}<|tool|>{{ .Content }}{{ end }}{{ end }}<|assistant|>"""
PARAMETER stop "<|endoftext|>"
PARAMETER stop "<|user|>"
PARAMETER stop "<|assistant|>"
